The '''LCK 2019 Spring''' was the first split of the 2019 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games and held offline at LoL Park in Seoul, South Korea, from January 16 to April 13, 2019. The Finals took place at Jamsil Indoor Stadium in Seoul. Matches were played on Patches 9.1 through 9.6. The Regular Season was played in a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs followed a Single Elimination King of the Hill format with Best-of-Five series from Round 1 onwards. Ten teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the split champion qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|2019 Mid-Season Invitational]]. [[DAMWON Gaming]] and [[SANDBOX Gaming]] joined the league through the [[LCK/2019/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]].

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''January 16th - March 31st, 2019''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2019/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2019/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs''' - ''April 3rd - April 13th, 2019''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Top 4 qualifies for [[Rift Rivals/2019/LCK-LMS-LPL|Rift Rivals 2019 - LCK vs LMS vs LPL]]
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|Mid-Season Invitational 2019]]
*'''MVP Points'''
** Regular Season & WildCard, Playoffs R1-R2 | 100pts
** Finals | 300pts
